roleplay.title: Hello and goodbye at a shop

hints.en: Answer the owner's welcome with a hello.
Point at the item and ask for one of these.
Ask the owner to speak slowly, please.
Say thank you formally, then the goodbye for when you are the one leaving.
Count from one to ten with the native numbers you use for counting things.
hints.t: 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯, 여섯, 일곱, 여덟, 아홉, 열.

hints.en: Count from one to ten with the Sino-Korean numbers.
hints.t: 일, 이, 삼, 사, 오, 육, 칠, 팔, 구, 십.

hints.en: Say fifteen thousand: ten thousand plus five thousand.
Ask Junho to say it once more.
